scams.name: Hua Hin Taxi Mafia Threats & Grab Attacks
scams.description: You book a Grab from your Hua Hin hotel to the train station. The Grab driver picks you up. A tuk-tuk driver nearby throws an egg at the Grab car window. Community reports document this exact aggressive enforcement: 'The taxi mafia there are terrible! I've both been aggressively threatened by a taxi driver and scammed (meter tampering).' Another traveler wrote: 'Similar situation happened a few weeks ago — it made the news. The taxi mafia were throwing eggs at a Grab car after picking up a customer.' Hua Hin's taxi cartel is more physically aggressive than most — other community reports mention 'taxi mafia in Hua Hin at the train station too.'
scams.avoidance: Walk 200–300m away from the Hua Hin train station and Market Village before requesting Grab Pre-book hotel transfers via your accommodation for arrivals — fixed price in writing Benchmark Grab fares: Hua Hin town center → Khao Takiab ฿100, → railway station ฿80, → Cicada Market ฿120 For short in-town moves, walk or rent a bicycle at ฿100/day — Hua Hin is walkable Report egg-throwing or threatening incidents to Tourist Police 1155 with vehicle plate — these made news in 2025
scams.location: Hua Hin Railway Station, Market Village area, Khao Takiab, Hua Hin town centre

scams.name: Hua Hin Strip Club / Brothel Bill Extortion
scams.description: You enter a Soi Bintabaht bar that a tout has recommended. A hostess sits down, drinks appear, and a 'bar fine' of ฿1,500 is added to take a girl off-shift. At the end of the night your bill is ฿15,000+ with line items you don't recognize. When you dispute, four men move between you and the door. Community reports document the pattern: a tourist in Thailand stands firm and refuses to pay his padded bill at a strip club/brothel that is infamous for such scams, and cowardly bouncers try to enforce payment. Hua Hin's nightlife scene is smaller than Pattaya's or Bangkok's Patpong, but the scam structure is identical — inflated bills, blocked exits, physical intimidation.
scams.avoidance: Avoid any bar a street tout pulls you toward — this is the single most reliable scam indicator Pay for each drink individually at the bar — never a tab Carry ฿2,000 cash only, leave all cards and passports at the hotel Stick to bars with posted prices and Google Maps reviews (Monsoon Bar, Hilton rooftop, El Murphy's) If padded bill and exit blocked, call Tourist Police 1155 on speaker — venues fold at the police mention
scams.location: Soi Bintabaht (Hua Hin's nightlife strip), Soi 80, Soi 94 bar areas

scams.name: Hua Hin Zoo & Attraction Dual Pricing (English Menu Markup)
scams.description: At Hua Hin Zoo (Santorini Park area) you see a sign in Thai posting admission at ฿80 — but the English counter ticket reads ฿300. Beyond the government-sanctioned 10x foreigner pricing at national sites, many private Hua Hin attractions run informal dual pricing. One traveler wrote: 'At Hua Hin, like a zoo (back of Hua Hin), the price-list writing with the number in Thai is much cheaper than the price list in English' — meaning the Thai-language price board shows one number, the English one shows a different one, without any legal basis for the markup.
scams.avoidance: Google attraction prices before arriving — Hua Hin Zoo real foreign admission is ฿350 as of 2025 Ask to see both English and Thai menus at restaurants; prices should match for same dishes Walk 2–3 blocks inland from Hua Hin beach for local-priced restaurants Cicada Market weekend vendors are near-fair priced; beachfront vendors are heavily marked up Use Google Maps reviews (4.3+ average, 100+ reviews) to filter out tourist-price traps
scams.location: Hua Hin Zoo, Vana Nava Water Jungle, Cicada Market, beach restaurants

scams.name: Hua Hin Property & Condo Agent Fraud
scams.description: Long-term tourists and expats in Hua Hin face a specialized scam: property agents selling condos they don't legally own, taking full cash payments, and disappearing. One traveler wrote: 'We bought a condo in Hua Hin a month ago and we paid all the money. Still not received the official blue book. Other people we know in Thailand keep saying it's very suspicious' — the 'blue book' (tabien baan) is the property ownership document; without it, you have no proof of purchase. Community reports also flag specific Hua Hin condo developments with systemic issues.
scams.avoidance: Never pay cash upfront for property purchase — use an escrow lawyer (฿20,000–฿50,000 in fees is standard) Verify ownership at the Thai Land Department before paying any deposit For short-term (under 3 months), use Booking.com, Airbnb, or Agoda with credit card Verify agent license via Thai Real Estate Broker Association (treba.or.th) If scammed, file with Tourist Police 1155 immediately — 2025 enforcement actions have succeeded
scams.location: Hua Hin condo developments, property agent offices, 'off-market' deals via touts

scams.name: Beach Jet Ski & Watersports Damage Shakedown (Lighter Variant)
scams.description: Hua Hin Beach's jet ski rental scam is the less-famous cousin of Pattaya's and Phuket's — lower dollar amounts (฿5,000–฿15,000 damage claims rather than ฿30,000–฿300,000) but the same mechanics. Operators rent jet skis with pre-existing damage hidden under tape, 'discover' damage on return, and demand cash with a 'police' officer magically appearing to enforce. Community reports list Hua Hin alongside Pattaya and Samet as scam locations, and travelers note that the primary Thailand jet-ski rental scam pattern is well-documented with Hua Hin often mentioned in discussion.
scams.avoidance: Do not rent jet skis, parasail, or banana boats from Hua Hin beach operators — the scam risk outweighs the experience If you want watersports, book through a licensed resort (Hua Hin Marriott, Hyatt Regency) with written insurance Photograph equipment before use with timestamps; refuse rental if no pre-inspection sheet is offered Pay by credit card where possible for chargeback leverage If targeted, refuse to pay on the spot and call Tourist Police 1155 (not the 'officer' on scene)
scams.location: Hua Hin Beach main strip, Khao Takiab Beach, Pranburi
